task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Pick the mouse with scroll wheel with the right arm and place on the brown displaystand with rectangular opening.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架，用右臂拾取带有滚轮的鼠标，并放置在带有矩形开口的棕色展示架上。
